paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the quantity of AI Scientist publications on arXiv over three distinct time periods, categorized by whether the papers are with or without implementation details. The x-axis represents time categorically and lacks a specific axis title, displaying discrete tick labels for "Fall '24", "Winter '24", and "Spring '25". The y-axis is labeled "Quantity" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with numeric tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 3. The plot features two solid lines, both of which have corresponding shaded areas extending down to the x-axis. The "Without Implementation" category is represented by a solid turquoise line featuring circular markers with white borders; this line demonstrates a continuous increase across the x-axis, beginning at a value of 10 in Fall '24, rising to 15 in Winter '24, and ending at 21 in Spring '25. The "With Implementation" category is depicted by a solid light orange line featuring square markers with white borders, which similarly exhibits a steady upward trend, starting at an initial value of 2 in Fall '24, increasing to 7 in Winter '24, and concluding at 13 in Spring '25.
